about.title: Two developers from Győr who work precisely and fast
about.intro: We are two close friends from Győr. We qualified as software developers at Jedlik Ányos Technical School and are now studying Computer Science Engineering (BSc) at Széchenyi István University. We are at home in frontend, backend and mobile, and we work with the latest technologies.
about.storyText: We work alongside our studies, which lets us keep our prices below typical agency rates. The fresh, university-level knowledge and hands-on experience are all there: we plan precisely, build quickly and take deadlines seriously.
